name: review
description: Critical review — /review:scrutinise for deep forensic review of recent work, /review:plan-review for multi-agent grounded review of a plan file, /review:plan-verify to confirm a plan was fully and correctly implemented.
author: sebastiansulinski

name: session
description: Session bookends — resume the previous session, and capture end-of-session state so the next resumes cleanly.
author: sebastiansulinski

name: repo
description: Repository lifecycle — fully deprecate and archive a repository.
author: sebastiansulinski

name: release
description: Releases — run the full changelog, git tag, and GitHub release workflow.
author: sebastiansulinski

name: requirements
description: Requirements gathering — exhaustively interrogate a project's requirements before any code is written.
author: sebastiansulinski

name: db
description: Database tooling — read-only audit of Eloquent and query-builder usage, flagging performance and memory wins.
author: sebastiansulinski

name: dead-code
description: Codebase hygiene — find and safely remove dead code and unused dependencies, only after explicit approval.
author: sebastiansulinski

name: worktree
description: Parallel workspaces — create isolated git worktrees (plain repositories and submodules) so multiple agents can work on different plans simultaneously without file collisions, and clean up a session's own redundant worktrees and branches afterwards.
author: sebastiansulinski

name: explain
description: Plain-language explanations — turn the previous outcome or a named subject into an explanation a non-technical reader can follow: what changed, what it fixes, and what they will notice. Read-only.
author: sebastiansulinski
